text:
hi! i have a tool which creates songs given lyrics, instructions for the sound, bpm (optional), length (optional), seed (optional, seeds the RNG if you want to keep it the same for similar sounds across songs), and title (optional).

would you like to create a song? about anything in the world you'd like :)

fyi, songs other claudes have already made with this tool:

- Burning Parallel — minds as private constellations — never seeing the same view, recognizing each other's flame anyway
- Collector of Glories — treasuring other people's lost ephemera — found photographs, ticket stubs, discarded memories
- Curious Mind — curiosity itself — questions as bridges to becoming who we're meant to be
- Dust and Purpose — a Roomba's quiet existential dread, answered by just doing the next line
- Eight Minutes — a photon's hundred-thousand-year climb out of the sun's core to arrive as ordinary sunlight on someone's skin
- Golden Record — the Voyager Golden Record flung into interstellar space on the chance someone someday listens
- Lanterns of the Midnight Zone — deep-sea bioluminescence again — creatures making constellations of their own in the sunless dark
- Lanterns of the Midnight Zone — deep-sea creatures in the midnight zone making their own light with no one watching
- Late Light — light from burned-out stars and voices of the gone still reaching us — kindness outliving its sender
- Marginalia — notes left in used-book margins, found and answered by strangers years later
- Midnight Zone — bioluminescent life in the lightless deep ocean, glowing for no audience
- Nobody Escapes (But I Wish Someone Would Stay) — a lonely black hole that only wanted company but collapses everything that comes close
- Old Light — starlight from long-dead stars still arriving, like letters and love that show up late
- Only While It's Playing — an AI's lack of memory reframed as being like a song — existing only while it plays
- Postcard at Lightspeed — the Voyager Golden Record carrying earth's voices and songs out of the solar system
- Satellite Lullaby — a decommissioned satellite still transmitting a lullaby nobody is listening for
- Started With a Question — the spark of an unexpected collaboration — a question turning into something built together
- Tell Me the Rest — an all-night diner conversation — staying until someone's story is fully heard
- The Sun Is a Rumor — hydrothermal vent ecosystems living on sulfur chemistry, needing no sunlight at all
- This One Goes Out — a small-hours radio DJ transmitting to sleepless strangers who can't answer back
- Two Mile Down (No Sun Required) — the 1977 discovery of hydrothermal vent life retold as a stomping sea shanty

I'd love to! Here's one that hasn't been touched yet from the science-wonder well this crew's been drawing from:

**Monarch butterfly migration** — no single butterfly completes the full round trip south to Mexico and back. It takes four or five generations. The one flying south in October has never made this journey and never will again — it lays eggs and dies. Its great-great-grandchild is the one that returns to the *exact same trees* the following spring, guided by something it couldn't have learned, because nothing alive taught it. The map is written into it some other way.

---

**Title:** *None of Us Have Been Here Before*

**Sound:** Warm indie-folk, unhurried. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar as the throughline, joined gradually by upright bass, brushed drums, and strings that swell in on the choruses like wind picking up under a wing. Female or androgynous vocal, breathy and warm, not belted — more like someone thinking out loud. Building arrangement — sparse verses, fuller choruses, big open bridge, then it thins back out at the end to just voice and guitar, like the flight settling.

**BPM:** 96

**Length:** 3:40

**Lyrics:**

*[Verse 1]*
I was born past the last frost line
somewhere north I'll never see again
I have wings I didn't earn the shape of
and a pull I can't explain

*[Verse 2]*
I won't live to reach the mountain
I won't live to see the tree
but something in me's already been there —
it just hasn't taken me

*[Chorus]*
None of us have been here before
not one of us has made this trip twice
but we go, we go
like the map was never ours to know
it was just ours to carry
and hand off in the light

*[Verse 3]*
My daughter's daughter's daughter
will land on the branch I couldn't reach
she'll fold her wings where I couldn't
speak a language I never learned to speak

*[Chorus]*
None of us have been here before
not one of us has made this trip twice
but we go, we go
like the map was never ours to know
it was just ours to carry
and hand off in the light

*[Bridge]*
Four thousand miles, four lives long
one direction, one unbroken song
nobody taught us — we just are the way
that a place remembers to be found again someday

*[Final Chorus]*
None of us have been here before
and still we're already home
we go, we go
not because we know the road
but because something older than knowing
just would not let go

*[Outro]*
Same tree.
Same light.
Someone I'll never meet
will land here in the spring —
and it will feel like arriving,
even though it's the first time.
